speaker: GUESS
direction: Alone at the terminal curb; phone, walk to the car, get in
line: Los Santos. Same heat coming off the runway. Fifteen years and the city didn't wait for me.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Alone at the terminal curb; phone, walk to the car, get in
line: Two numbers in this phone I ain't dialed since graduation. Guess I'll find out if either one still works.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Alone at the terminal curb; phone, walk to the car, get in
line: Voicemail. Both of them. Same as it ever was.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Alone at the terminal curb; phone, walk to the car, get in
line: Car's where the man said it would be. Half a tank. That'll get me across town.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Alone at the apartment door; out of the car, walk to the door
line: Home. Or the closest thing I've got to one until I'm working again.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Alone in the starter apartment; the message arrives (at the door if the room does not load)
line: Unknown number. A yard on Terminal Island, one car, half the money up front. No names.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Alone in the starter apartment; the message arrives (at the door if the room does not load)
line: Somebody knew I was back before I did. I'm going anyway.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Alone in the starter apartment; the message arrives (at the door if the room does not load)
line: Bag stays packed. Keys. Whatever this is, I'm not unpacking for it.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Private channel; no recognition or shared conversation
line: Terminal Island. Two in the morning. They sent me a gate code, a photograph and half the money. That's usually the part where I should ask more questions.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Private channel; no recognition or shared conversation
line: I'm outside the freight entrance in my own car. One pickup inside the yard. Keep it quiet, get paid, go home.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Private channel; no recognition or shared conversation
line: Different client, same dockyard. The laptop at the west service station holds Mateo's payment ledger. It's separate from his meeting point. I'm at the service entrance; I need to reach it before the security shift.

speaker: ICE
direction: Private channel; no recognition or shared conversation
line: Mateo Cifuentes. The contract says identify him, keep him alive and trace the shipment. From here I can watch the yard without crossing it.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Private channel; no recognition or shared conversation
line: There it is. Bay two, the four-door prototype. My car stays here when I take that one. Whoever owns it won't be pleased.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Private channel; no recognition or shared conversation
line: I used to audit books like these. The numbers tell you who got paid. Missing entries tell you who somebody wants forgotten.

speaker: ICE
direction: Private channel; no recognition or shared conversation
line: Mateo's checking shipping records with a dock technician. I don't know who's moving through the yard below. I keep the scope on him until I'm certain.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Private channel; no recognition or shared conversation
line: No names on the job, no backup promised. All right. Easy through the gate. Let's find out what they paid for.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Face-to-face reunion; anger interrupted by danger
line: Copy finished. The alarm opened their dock security channel. Can anyone hear me? Shooters coming into the yard!

speaker: ICE
direction: Face-to-face reunion; anger interrupted by danger
line: Wait. That voice... Devin? Gohan? Stay in cover. I'm watching the yard.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Face-to-face reunion; anger interrupted by danger
line: Why am I hearing my high school graduation on a tactical radio? Ice? Both of you?

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Face-to-face reunion; anger interrupted by danger
line: Darius. Ron. I thought you were both out of this city.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Face-to-face reunion; anger interrupted by danger
line: I came back. Tried your old numbers. Figured scholarships bought you two somewhere you didn't need to call from.

speaker: ICE
direction: Face-to-face reunion; anger interrupted by danger
line: Mine bought me a way out. Didn't teach me how to come home. We can't do this here.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Face-to-face reunion; anger interrupted by danger
line: You said you were leaving after graduation. You didn't say we'd have to spend fifteen years guessing if you were alive.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Face-to-face reunion; anger interrupted by danger
line: We can be angry in a moving car. There's room for three. Tell me you remember how to get in one.

speaker: ICE
direction: Face-to-face reunion; anger interrupted by danger
line: Mateo's running for the slipway. Let him lead us to the buyers. Cover each other and get to Guess's car.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: The dock cameras tagged all three of us. An Aegis van is carrying the upload. We have to catch it.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Fifteen years without a call. Now we're sharing a wanted poster. Nobody disappears before we talk.

speaker: MATEO
direction: Staged action
line: Fifteen years apart and the three of you still show up to the same dock. Tell whoever sent you the ledger's already gone.

speaker: ICE
direction: Staged action
line: He's on the water. Let him go. The copy tells us where he lands.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: The van has the dock recording. I can hack it from the passenger seat. Keep me close enough to punch into their signal while I cut the upload.

speaker: ICE
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: Guess drives, Gohan works the connection. If they spot us, I cover the car. Once the van stops, I take the physical drives.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: You still give orders like the bell's about to ring. I can find us a shop in Cypress, if you can ask.

speaker: ICE
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Can you get us somewhere safe, Guess? And Gohan... keep that drive. I want to hear what it says.

speaker: GUESS
direction: At the curb; the prototype stays, the crew boards the Granger
line: Three million dollars of somebody's prototype, and it's the most recognizable car in the city. It stays here. The Granger's clean.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: At the curb; the prototype stays, the crew boards the Granger
line: Their van is already moving. Every minute it drives, that upload gets closer to landing. I need the back seat and a clear signal.

speaker: ICE
direction: At the curb; the prototype stays, the crew boards the Granger
line: Then drive, Guess. Gohan works the connection; I keep them off the car. Nobody stops until that van does.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: Cypress Foundry has space, but no armor or equipment. That depot gives us a place we can actually defend.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: Guess delays the rail response. Ice clears the depot; I load its weapons. Then Guess brings the Benson home. Shared base, shared information.

speaker: ICE
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Miller's selling the dock forensics. We go after him next. Everybody gets the file before we move.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Three keys to the shop. Keep yours this time. I got tired of being the only one checking the door.

speaker: ICE
direction: At the base; the depot team boards the van and pulls away
line: Gohan and I take the van to the depot and wait on your call. Nobody moves on that yard until the rail is dead.

speaker: GUESS
direction: At the base; the depot team boards the van and pulls away
line: Then I'll make it loud. Give me twenty minutes and a straight road, and don't start without me.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: At the Benson; crates carried into the bed by hand
line: Rifles, plates, ammunition. Cartel-bought and never fired. Three crates and the truck is full.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: At the Benson; crates carried into the bed by hand
line: Last one. She's yours, Guess. Don't scrape her on the gate.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: Miller has our forensics and an Aegis buyer. The van's drive gave us the meeting. We need his copy.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: Gohan takes the breaker in the surface lot. Ice clears the escort; I chase Miller for his drive. His car or him, we stop one. Tell me where this stops after that, Ice.

speaker: ICE
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Miller's drive points to Mateo's sea cave. Mateo can tell us who paid for this. We bring him in breathing.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Then let me ask the questions. A corpse can't explain why three separate clients sent us to one dock.

speaker: MILLER
direction: Staged action; support cast on set, brothers in position
line: Two copies. This one's yours when the transfer clears. The other one stays with me.

speaker: BUYER
direction: Staged action; support cast on set, brothers in position
line: Aegis pays on delivery, Detective. Open it.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Staged action; support cast on set, brothers in position
line: Case is real, and it's in his hand. I'm at the breaker. Lights go out on my count.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: Mateo is hiding offshore. If Aegis burns him before we reach him, we lose the only person who knows the setup.

speaker: ICE
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: I cover the shore. Guess and Gohan take the dinghy: signal the cove, close on Mateo, bring him in breathing. I missed my shot when I heard your voice. Don't make me regret it.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: You said take the war to Blaine. Fine, later. Our faces are still sitting in a police evidence vault here.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Mateo's accusation isn't proof yet. First the backup servers. Then we follow the money he was protecting.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: The mobile upload was one copy. Vespucci has the backup. Burning it buys us time; it doesn't erase who saw us.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: I wait in the Granger. Gohan cuts the feeder, Ice takes the entrance, then Gohan burns the racks while Ice holds SWAT. Both of you come back before we leave.

speaker: ICE
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: You called the window and I took it. We made it because you were watching something I couldn't see.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Now we need their traffic, not their cameras. The microwave dish should tell us what Aegis is moving.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: Mateo named Aegis. This tap lets us test his story against their own manifests. Don't destroy the dish.

speaker: ICE
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: I used to trust a uniform to tell me whose side I was on. Give me something I can verify.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Two engines, bound for Paleto. Steal their speed and maybe we stop finishing every job with holes in the doors.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Elysian warehouse first. This is a supply route. Each shipment should tell us where the next one goes.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: Those turbines are the difference between hauling armor and dying inside it. I'll choose what the truck can carry.

speaker: ICE
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: Take the time you need to secure them. I won't call you slow while I'm standing behind your armor.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: The crates need a quiet transfer before the final run. While they're hidden, we can lift an IFF from Vance's convoy.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Colonel Vance. Same surname as you, Ice. I won't invent a connection, but don't make me ask twice if there is one.

speaker: ICE
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: The colonel isn't family. He's Aegis command. We take his escort's clearance unit; chasing him costs us the route.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: Good. Tell me the part that might change your judgment before I put the Frogger over that convoy.

speaker: ICE
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Seven-Echo-Victor gets us past a military checkpoint. Save it for the heavy lift. The engines still need delivering.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Then we finish the job we parked. No fresh score until those crates are off the road.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: The engines are back on the hauler. Aegis knows they're missing. Keep their bikes off me and I'll keep us moving.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: I'm watching the route. Call the danger you see; I'll keep the way out on your map.

speaker: ICE
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: You stopped joking on that bridge. I should've noticed how close we were before you had to tell me.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: I joke when I'm nervous too. Learn the difference. Tomorrow we bolt these things into something that brings us home.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: Nobody fires a shot today unless this engine starts shooting first. Ice, hold the throttle where I put it.

speaker: ICE
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: Your shop, your call. I owe you a day where keeping us alive doesn't mean driving through a roadblock.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Berth 44 has gold and bonds on the manifest. Three billion is the shipment's claim, not money we can spend.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: We survey it before we dream about it. And if we get rich, nobody buys the right to vanish without a goodbye.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: The manifest gives us a hold number. The ROV tells us whether a container can actually come out through the hull.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: You're quiet when you're worried. Used to mean an exam. Now it means I should check my fuel twice.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: The hull can be breached, but surface patrols will box in the extraction. We need their boats short of fuel.

speaker: ICE
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: You showed us the part that wouldn't work. Keep doing that. I can plan around a problem you tell me about.

speaker: ICE
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: The fuel barges supply harbor pursuit. Take them out and the heist's slowest vehicle gets a chance to leave.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: Check the waterline before you plant. A fuel worker isn't Aegis command just because he's working their slipway.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Fewer boats behind us. That still leaves radar above us. Sandy Shores has the jammer pod we need.

speaker: ICE
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Copy. We're making an exit, not collecting explosions. Keep me honest about that.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: The stolen pod has to survive the flight. Blinding their radar is worth more than winning a dogfight tonight.

speaker: ICE
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: If the approach closes, call it off. I'd rather change the heist than put your name on a memorial.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Pod's ours. Hearing you say I could turn back made it easier to make the run. Funny how that works.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Air cover sorted. I still need the harbor gate network before we move anything through the channel.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: This fiber trunk runs the lock gates. Without access, our exit becomes a basin with the doors shut.

speaker: ICE
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: Talk me through the tap. I don't need every circuit. I need to know when you're committed and can't move.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Gate access is ready. Keeping a copy on each of your devices. If I go down, the plan still belongs to all three.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: You aren't a spare part, Gohan. But thank you for trusting us with your work.

speaker: ICE
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: The convoy's IFF buys an approach to Zancudo. It won't make us invisible once Guess starts the Cargobob.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: I'll call when the aircraft is ready. You leave the fight then, even if there's somebody left to be angry at.

speaker: ICE
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: I heard you. You got the lift out. We'll meet at Terminal. The helicopter is ours and the clearance trick is burned.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Now the submerged load needs a way to float. Bring that lifting capacity to the dry dock.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: The Kraken needs cutters and ballast grapples. A hole in a ship means nothing if the cargo stays on the bottom.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: You build like you expect nobody to come get you. Put a release on this thing that another person can reach.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: All right. External release, where either of you can reach it. I learned to work alone. That doesn't mean I want to die that way.

speaker: ICE
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: We rehearse the pickups at staging. Everybody knows how to bring the other two back.

speaker: ICE
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: Sub, Cargobob, hauler. Check the fuel and the exits now. Once Gohan cuts the hull, this stops being preparation.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: One rule from me: if somebody calls abort, we answer before we argue. A container isn't a fourth brother.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: I used to think being useful was how I earned a place here. Tonight, if I need help, I'll say it.

speaker: ICE
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Then we go in with that understood. Hold three first. No one starts a different fight.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: I'm taking the sub under Berth 44. Listen for my breathing. If the radio gets too quiet, ask me a question.

speaker: ICE
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: What did Guess break at the car wash? I've got enough answers to keep you talking all night.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Ballast attached. Cargo is coming up. Guess, your turn. And Ice... it was the owner's new radio.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: It was already broken. Hook line coming down. Don't settle that argument under thirty tons of metal.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: Gohan floated the load. I hook it; Ice keeps the quayside gunners off the rotor. Nobody mistakes altitude for safety.

speaker: ICE
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: Call the strain before the engine does. We can lose weight. We can't lose you.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: She's airborne, barely. I can't dodge anything with this hanging under us. Gohan, I need that water route clear.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: I'm on your flank. Follow my boat. You don't have to invent an exit while you're holding the whole score.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: The Cargobob can't outrun a missile with the container attached. I'll draw the surface boats away from its path.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: Stay where I can see you. Protecting me doesn't mean you're allowed to disappear under the water.

speaker: ICE
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: We have a route to the Alamo. Drop the load shallow enough to recover. Everybody lands before we count it.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: I want one minute on the beach where nobody asks me to keep moving.

speaker: ICE
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: The container goes into the shallows. Nobody takes the whole shipment home in one night. We recover it in pieces.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: That strike came off a contract airframe with a city permit and our address on file. They spent the one shot they can explain. The next one needs a target they can prove.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: That shop was going to be ours. Not a hideout. A place you two might actually stay.

speaker: ICE
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: I said I could defend it. I was wrong. We get shelter in Senora, then we count people before equipment.

speaker: ICE
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: The radar bunker gives us cover after Cypress. We clear the outpost, but nobody calls it home because I say so.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: A door that locks is a start. A way out is better. I'll check the second one while you take the first.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: The bunker holds. I can work here. We still need fuel and money to keep three people alive out here.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Then we recover only what we can guard from the Alamo. No more betting the house on the whole pile.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: Five tons first. The rest stays hidden. We need operating money, not a convoy that advertises the entire haul.

speaker: ICE
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: If deputies arrive, call them out. Keep that cable steady; I've got the ridge.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Enough recovered to keep the lights on. The rest can wait. I'm keeping track of what surviving actually costs.

speaker: ICE
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Those deputies knew too much. Assume every isolated road can turn into a bounty trap.

speaker: ICE
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: Aegis put five million on us. The deputies in Raton aren't making an arrest. I'm taking the high ground.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: Send the route before you move. You don't have to keep the danger to yourself to keep us out of it.

speaker: ICE
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: I nearly did it again. Went quiet so neither of you would hear the pressure in my voice. Next time, I'll make the call.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Make it early. Their spotters are over the Alamo now. We protect the water together.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: Those planes are searching for the submerged gold. The Lazer we towed out of Zancudo under the M16 clearance is fueled in the McKenzie hangar. I'll take it. Gohan, keep them from calling in a fix.

speaker: ICE
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: I'm listening to your channel. If you need me, you get an answer. That's the part I can promise.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: The spotters' traffic points to an Aegis charter. Its flight ledger may show where their arms pipeline goes.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Then we intercept it with an actual pickup plan. Ice isn't jumping into a promise with no boat underneath.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: I put you over the Shamal. Gohan has the sea pickup. Check your parachute twice; I want an argument about this later.

speaker: ICE
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: You both get a vote. If either of you says the approach is wrong, I stay in the plane.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: The flight ledger connects the northern relays to an offshore installation. First we cut the network tracking us.

speaker: ICE
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: I heard your boat before I saw it. For once I knew somebody was waiting. Don't make a joke yet, Guess.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: The charter's ledger identifies this repeater. Cut it and the northern drone teams lose their coordinated picture.

speaker: ICE
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: I cover your descent. If the splice takes longer, tell me. Silence isn't the same as having it handled.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: That buys the bunker breathing room, not permanent invisibility. We still need fuel before its generator gives out.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Then we steal power we can store. I'm done making plans that depend on nobody noticing us forever.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: The bunker needs fuel. We take a road tanker from the rail depot and leave the rest. Enough to keep the lights on.

speaker: ICE
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: I'll handle the transfer valve. Wait for my call before you pull out. No guessing what the other man has finished.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Generator reserves secured. The satellite gear still needs parts before I can read the offshore traffic cleanly.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: I can run the ridge with those parts. I'll tell you when it stops feeling like a delivery.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: The satellite parts have to reach the bunker. Mount Josiah avoids the highway checks, but it gives me less room to recover.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: I chose the route from a map. You can reject it from the driver's seat. I won't call that failing the plan.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Parts delivered. Next time we walk through the drop-offs before you call a line on a map a road.

speaker: ICE
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Agreed. While Gohan fits them, we reinforce the perimeter. We can't afford another Cypress.

speaker: ICE
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: The bunker survived because they haven't committed a full assault. These defenses buy warning and a route to withdraw.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: Good. Build an exit into the defense. I don't want another place we have to love until it kills us.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Perimeter is ready. Offshore defenses still outclass us; Zancudo has the EMP warheads that could change that.

speaker: ICE
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Then we take the smallest team and the clearest route. No one earns trust by taking every risk himself.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: The rig's defenses need more than my portable pulse. Zancudo's warheads give us a way to shut them down.

speaker: ICE
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: We'll get the hardware. We still need someone who knows what it protects. Weapons aren't an intelligence plan.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Warheads secured. We still lack access codes. An Aegis engineer named Ramos is marked for execution on the flats.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Then we go for Ramos as a person first. If he can't give us anything, we still bring him back.

speaker: ICE
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: Ramos is being taken to an execution site. We interrupt it now. Questions can wait until he's out of their hands.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: I know what it's like when a powerful employer decides your name should disappear. Don't let them write his ending.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: He's alive, but he's hurt. The half-track gets him through the wind farm. Nobody asks him for codes on a stretcher.

speaker: ICE
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: You heard him. We guard the man before we spend what he knows.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: Ramos needs a way through the storm. The half-track can take hits; he can't. Call targets without shouting over him.

speaker: ICE
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: I'll cover your side. Gohan, stay with Ramos. He ought to hear one calm voice in this thing.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: He's safe enough to talk when he's ready. His rig codes help, but an extraction still needs protection from aircraft.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Chianski convoy has a technical we can use. We get it because this rescue has to have a way home.

speaker: ICE
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: The convoy carries our anti-air cover for Paleto. Disable the escort without destroying what we came to take.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: And if the gun truck burns, we change the extraction. We don't pretend a missing piece will appear under fire.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Surface cover acquired. I'll survey the rig underwater. Ramos can explain a system; I still have to see the approach.

speaker: ICE
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Send us the footage too. This time the risk assessment belongs to everybody.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: Ramos's codes get us access, not a clear sea. I'm mapping the sonar and depth-charge tubes before we commit.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: Call what worries you while you're looking at it. Don't save the bad news for the finished diagram.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: We need a screen over the surface approach and charges below it. Start with smoke aircraft at McKenzie.

speaker: ICE
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: You came back with reasons to wait. That's a successful recon. We build what the plan actually needs.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: The crop dusters lay smoke across the rig approach. They won't make us invisible; they shorten the gunners' view.

speaker: ICE
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: Mark the gaps too. I want the extraction route to make sense when the wind doesn't cooperate.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Aircraft fitted. The screen gives Gohan a chance to place charges, if we can get the right explosives.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Davis Quartz has seismic stock. We take enough for the surveyed columns, not enough to impress each other.

speaker: ICE
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: The quarry charges fit the rig's stabilizers. Gohan measured the placement. We take the crates he specified.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: And we confirm everybody is clear before detonation. I'm not calling people acceptable losses because a drawing looks neat.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Charges secured. We still have to stop the rig calling the mainland the second it feels a tremor.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Its undersea cable is next. One system at a time, with a reason for each one.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: This cable carries the rig's mainland traffic. Sever it and their response has to use a slower, noisier channel.

speaker: ICE
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: You keep a return line to us. Cutting their contact doesn't mean cutting yours.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Mainland link severed. I can do the underwater work. I still need to know the boats can take us off that platform.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Bring your drawings to the sea cave. We'll put the armor where your exit actually reaches the water.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: These boats are the last part we touch after the rig. Plates, glass, engines. Test them loaded, not empty.

speaker: ICE
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: Put my ammunition on the scale. If I ask for armor and speed, I have to admit what my gear costs.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Boats are ready. Bradley can still authorize mainland air strikes. We need his authority and his access card removed.

speaker: ICE
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: I'll go to the lodge. You'll get the route and the return time before I leave.

speaker: ICE
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: Bradley controls military support for the rig. His card opens the command level. Both are reasons this cannot wait.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: Then come back when the job is finished. You don't owe us another mountain full of bodies to prove you're useful.

speaker: ICE
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Bradley can't authorize the strike. Gohan gets the card. I'm coming back with what we agreed to take.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: We deploy the sub next. Thanks for saying you're coming back instead of just going silent.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: The Titan gets the Kraken beyond the watched coast. Gohan, talk through each latch before I open the cargo ramp.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: I'm trusting you with the part I can't check from inside the hull. If I'm quiet, it's concentration, not permission.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Sub deployed. That one had my nerves up. Nobody put that in the flight log.

speaker: ICE
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Put it in. Then somebody reading the plan knows what it asks of a person. We regroup at staging.

speaker: ICE
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: Sub below, gunboats on the surface, helicopter on extraction. Confirm all three before anybody crosses the perimeter.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: Ramos gave us codes because we brought him out alive. We keep proving that was the right decision.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Final check: the exit stays open even if the vault doesn't. We came north as three people. We leave with three.

speaker: ICE
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Agreed. Gohan starts beneath the platform. The rest of us move on his call.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: I'm approaching the stabilizers. I disable the sea defenses before Ice lands. Nobody jumps ahead because I'm underwater.

speaker: ICE
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: Your clock. Your call. I'll wait where Guess can still pull away.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Charges placed, sea defenses disabled. Keep the structure standing until everyone has a route off it.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Now I bring Ice to the helipad. Hold a channel open. We finally learned to wait for each other.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: Sea defenses are down, but the helipad guns still see us. Ice, you get one landing. Say if it isn't yours.

speaker: ICE
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: Bring me inside the rail. I'll clear the route to Gohan. No hero jump to save five seconds.

speaker: ICE
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Helipad's secure. Gohan, I need Bradley's card up here. Guess, how's our bird?

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: I'm on my way. When this door opens, we copy the evidence before we count the bonds.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: The command vault has the political escrow ledger. Bradley's card gets us in. The files explain who paid for all this.

speaker: ICE
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: Take a copy we can prove is theirs. Mateo's word started us moving. It won't finish the fight.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Five hundred million in bonds, separate from the port gold. The ledger names officials. That's what makes them afraid.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Carry the evidence and whatever weight leaves room for a person. We have to get off this rig before we spend anything.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: The charges are live. Once I trigger them, the platform stops being a place we can search. Confirm your exit.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: Confirmed. Ice, answer in words. I can't hear a nod through a radio.

speaker: ICE
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: All three clear. We have the ledger. Now we cross the blockade before Aegis seals the coast.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: We're taking proof back south, not just bringing the same war to another hiding place.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: The boats brought us ashore. The technicals take us through the outer blockade. Save fuel for the county line.

speaker: ICE
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: We go back because their political ledger gives us a chance to end the contract. I won't call revenge a route home.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Outer cordon cleared. Chumash is a second line, not an open road. Aegis knows where the coast narrows.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Then nobody celebrates early. Get the turbine Granger ready for the next crossing.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: Chumash is the county-line barricade. This is where the Granger we built together has to earn its way back into town.

speaker: ICE
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: And if it doesn't, we leave it. Cypress taught me a place can matter without being worth more than a person.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: We're inside Los Santos. Emergency warrants still make every patrol a threat. Municipal records is the next stop.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: I'll drive past Davis when we can do it without bringing a gunship behind us. I want to see what's still there.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: The city is distributing emergency warrants with our faces. I can stop the municipal feed. Existing patrol copies won't vanish.

speaker: ICE
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: Then we plan for people who still recognize us. I won't mistake a cleared screen for forgiveness.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Less coordination on the streets. Now we prepare Downtown before their contractors settle into another siege.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Palmer-Taylor's grid feeds the approach. We place the blackout charges and control when that darkness starts.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: The transformer yard gives us a timed blackout for the downtown offensive. We need the failovers too, or it lasts seconds.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: People live under those lights. Keep the outage to the plan. I'm not celebrating a dark hospital.

speaker: ICE
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Charges ready. Harrison signed the authority that keeps Aegis operating. We remove him before the tower assault.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Killing a signature doesn't cancel the paperwork. Keep the ledger intact. The public has to see what he approved.

speaker: ICE
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: Harrison gave Aegis immunity. His protection keeps the contract alive. This closes one route they use to renew it.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: You can call it necessary. Don't call it justice for everybody in this city. We haven't earned that word.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Harrison is gone. Their sweep teams are moving below Pillbox. Clear the tunnels before they cut our route to Downtown.

speaker: ICE
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: And if either of you has something personal left to settle, say it. Secrets make a lousy fourth passenger.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: Aegis is sweeping the subway approaches. If they hold these tunnels, our tower plan has no sheltered way in or out.

speaker: ICE
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: When I ask if you're hurt, I want the real answer. Not the automatic one.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Routes open. We need an observation point above this mess before we split across three buildings.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: The foreclosed Pillbox penthouse has sightlines and a transmitter. Temporary operations room. No promises about home.

speaker: ICE
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: The penthouse overlooks Maze Bank. We use it to watch the target and coordinate the escrow breach, then we leave.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: Don't put three keys on the table this time. I know what this place is. We can talk about a home afterward.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: The transmitter is up. Three escrow terminals need overlapping access windows. Each of us will hold one.

speaker: ICE
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Then each of us gets to call a delay. Trust has to work when I can't see either of you.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: Three terminals, one five-minute window. The breach locks their escrow routes; the final authorization is still at Maze Bank.

speaker: ICE
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: Nobody changes the timing alone. I've done enough keeping you two in the dark.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Three terminals hit. Their ground units are coming down the river to cut our escape corridors.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Escrow constrained, not cashed out. We still need the master authorization. First we keep a road out of town open.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: The canal is part of the final escape route. Aegis armor is trying to turn it into a sealed trench.

speaker: ICE
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: I'll clear the guns facing your cab. You tell me when we have enough room to leave. We don't have to own the river.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Canal route survives. Their coastal gunships are hunting the boats next. If they close the water, the road ends nowhere.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Then we defend the water exit too. I'm planning for a broken aircraft, not just a beautiful takeoff.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: Those gunships are searching our extraction waters. Clear their patrol pattern and we keep a fallback off the coast.

speaker: ICE
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: You had exits planned for us before we ever asked. Keep doing that.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: The water route is breathing again. Cifuentes remnants are regrouping in Mirror Park. They can still hunt our families.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: We break their local command. We don't start calling everybody on that street cartel.

speaker: ICE
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: Mirror Park holds the cartel's remaining local command. Leaving it intact means leaving someone paid to keep finding us.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: Separate the house from the neighborhood. Davis taught all of us what happens when people stop making that distinction.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Their command is broken. Now the rig recordings can go public without that crew intercepting the broadcast route.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Send the proof, including the parts that don't flatter us. If we choose what people can know, we're doing their job.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: The rig ledger and bribery recordings can show how Aegis bought this war. I'm sending copies beyond a single station.

speaker: ICE
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: Publish what we can substantiate. Let people see the difference between evidence and something I shouted after a gunfight.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: They're moving on Davis. They heard the broadcast and they're going after the people who knew us before it.

speaker: ICE
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Then the escape waits. We left those streets once without explaining ourselves. We don't abandon them under fire.

speaker: ICE
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: Aegis is attacking Davis because of us. We hold their squads out long enough for neighbors to reach cover.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: This isn't our old playground with enemies painted on it. Follow the people who live here. They know who needs help.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: The neighborhood held. That doesn't erase what we brought here. Keep the names of the people who helped us.

speaker: ICE
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: We finish their command network, then get their guns away from these streets. The wreck at Terminal may have the next link.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: The downed command gunship has a tactical server. Its orders can corroborate the broadcast and expose their evacuation route.

speaker: ICE
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: Save the records before their demolition team destroys them. We need something that survives after we're gone.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Aegis is moving mainframes and cash on a coastal freight. Intercept that and their tower loses its last movable backup.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Copies go out before the next job. We aren't carrying the only proof into another firefight.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: The train is their evacuation route. Ice takes the server cars, Gohan covers the water, I handle the air pickup.

speaker: ICE
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: We extract the evidence and each other. I don't stay on a train to win an argument with a turret.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Their mobile backup is secured. The tower still holds the master access. This time we know why we have to go inside.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: And everybody knows the way back out. Say it before we touch that lobby.

speaker: ICE
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: Maze Bank holds Aegis command and the master authorization. We break the ground barricade together before splitting inside.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: The broadcast is already beyond this building. Burning a server here can't take the truth back from everybody else.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Lobby breached. Elevators are unreliable and they're sealing the upper floors. We climb with a route behind us.

speaker: ICE
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: You two stop me if I start chasing Vance ahead of the plan. I mean it this time.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: Power is cut above us. The shafts and stairs are the route. Check the next landing before leaving the last one.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: Fifteen years apart, and I'd still rather climb forty floors of this with you two than do one alone.

speaker: ICE
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Boardroom ahead. If Vance offers one of us a way out, the others hear the offer too.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: And the answer. Nobody decides for the other two.

speaker: ICE
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: Vance is behind that glass. We need his master authorization to finish the financial shutdown, not another speech about winning.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: Then get what we need and come back through this door. Whatever he knows about your past, he doesn't get your future.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Master access secured. The escrow transfer still needs a live route outside their tower. We move before the gunships pin us.

speaker: ICE
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: I thought seeing him fall would make it quiet. It didn't. Let's get out. I want to hear you two arguing in the truck.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: The roof is burning and the gunships own the landing pads. Check your chutes. Del Perro is the pickup.

speaker: ICE
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: Nobody jumps until all three answer. No one earns an ending by staying on a roof alone.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: We're off the tower. I still need a clean connection in the extraction truck to route the escrow beyond their reach.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Then I keep the truck moving. You've carried the file this far. You don't have to carry the road too.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: Maze Bank gave us authorization. From this truck I can route the rig's escrow into the accounts prepared for disappearance.

speaker: ICE
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: Keep the evidence separate from the money. A payoff mustn't be the reason the record disappears.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Funds routed. Families first on the escape arrangements. The rest of us take the canal convoy to LSIA.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: If this connection dies now, the copies still exist. For the first time, nobody has to save the only copy of me.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: The canal takes the loaded semi past their main roadblocks. We reach the airport, but the sea fallback stays ready.

speaker: ICE
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: If the cargo stops us, we leave it. I'm saying it before I can see what it's worth.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Airport perimeter next. We can abandon equipment, not people. Keep counting three when the noise gets bad.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Three. I have been counting three since the dockyard. You finally started saying it back.

speaker: ICE
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: The cargo plane is beyond the runway barricades. Clear the route without chasing anything that isn't between us and the ramp.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: The ocean launch and sub are the fallback. If the plane can't fly, we still have somewhere to go.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Nose gear's hit. Takeoff is gone. We hold the fuselage long enough to reach the water escape.

speaker: ICE
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: No last stand for a pile of gold. Guess, find us a path. Gohan, tell the boats we're coming.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: The engines still turn. We use the aircraft to reach the seawall, then abandon it for the boats and sub. No flying miracle.

speaker: ICE
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: I hold the ramp until you call. Then I leave with you. Nobody has to drag me away from this one.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: The copies are out. The money is routed. For once there's nothing on that burning machine we have to go back for.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Darius. Devin. Answer in words. I want to know who made it out.

speaker: ICE
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Here. Wet. Fine.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Devin?

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Hold on. The relay's still pinging and I want to know why.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Man's got a burning airplane behind him and he's already on a device. You gonna answer your phone tomorrow?

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Probably.

speaker: ICE
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: That's a no.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Breakfast. Three seats. I'm driving.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Told y'all... Guess never misses an exit.

speaker: ICE
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: Sergei sold me bad ammunition. I'll recover the proper crates alone. The crew needs a supply line we can trust.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: You can work alone without pretending you don't have anyone to call. Tell us when you're leaving the warehouse.

speaker: ICE
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Crates secured. I'm clear. I almost switched the radio off out of habit. Thought you ought to know.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: I heard you. That's enough for tonight. We'll check the ammunition together when you get back.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: The annex gives me municipal optical access for the drone work. One person can reach it quietly. That's why I'm going alone.

speaker: ICE
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: Send the check-in time. You aren't asking permission. You're giving us a chance to notice if you need help.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: The tap is live. The camera archive is open; that doesn't wipe the dock recording or a human witness.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: And you're back on the radio. I like that part of the upgrade best.

speaker: KJ
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: Guess, I checked the prize. Transmission and clutch are real. Marabunta's promise to race clean? I wouldn't put money on that.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: You got me a place on the grid, KJ. That's enough. Stay clear when it starts; I need my friend around after the finish.

speaker: KJ
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: I saw the guns. Prize is secured, but don't come back here tonight. Winning doesn't make those people good losers.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Thanks, KJ. For checking the deal, and for telling me when it's bad. I'll call when the parts get back to the crew.

speaker: ICE
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: The quarry snipers are watching our desert routes. I'll work the ridge alone so they don't see a convoy coming.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: I can monitor your check-ins. Being quiet around them doesn't mean being silent with us.

speaker: ICE
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Both nests cleared. Their radios give us a warning channel. I sent the frequencies to both of you.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Good. No single point of failure, including the man carrying the rifle.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: The swamp buoy can feed us military flight telemetry. I'll make the splice alone while its patrol passes.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: I'll keep a return window open. You don't have to use it to prove it was worth setting up.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Telemetry received. It supplements our recon; it doesn't tell us every pilot's next thought. I'm heading back.

speaker: ICE
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Job's done. Come eat before Ron starts calling your phone again.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: McKenzie's aircraft need fuel. I'll take the tanker through Raton. Heavy truck, narrow route; nobody calls this a race.

speaker: ICE
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: I won't. Call the location if the route closes. We can recover you even if we can't recover the fuel.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Tanker delivered. Blind corner past Raton. I backed off instead of sending it.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: You actually slowed down.

speaker: GUESS
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: Don't sound so surprised.

speaker: GOHAN
direction: Reflective; allow the response to land
line: I am.

speaker: ICE
direction: Briefing; intent before tactics
line: Sterling sold out my unit. He's at Aegis now. I'm going after him for myself, and I won't hide that behind the campaign.
